N2 - AgentChatService: chats and managed alternative generation
|-- Turn and reference binding: startTurn() / MappingChatMcpBinding
|   |-- AgentChatPanel -> create/resume, send/readCanvas, interrupt/answer
|   |-- Own ChatSession: thread, turn, items, settings, tools and request IDs
|   |-- Capture canvas target and revision-pinned selection references
|   |   |-- ChatCanvasBindings captures target/access for each active turn
|   |   `-- References carry captured ASCII; edits validate current revisions
|   `-- Persist request identity before turn/start; stream events to listeners
|-- Supplied edit boundary: ChatDiagramTools -> agent.submitDirect()
|   |-- Resolve reference or nodeId; pin document version and base revision
|   |-- DiagramBatchService prepares operations[] for one atomic application
|   |-- Reuse C11/D04: FROM SUPPLIED EDIT TO SAVED CANVAS
|   |   `-- Pure revision -> explicit retention -> controller/history application
|   `-- Prompt generation is separate; managed children submit their own edits
|-- Generation preparation: genAlternatives() / CanvasHistory.startGeneration()
|   |-- GenerateAlternatives or bound tool supplies saved view and prompts
|   |   `-- 1-8 candidates; matching requestId/arguments reuse the receipt
|   |-- Live parent bridge captures one saved finalCheckpointId
|   |   |-- Excludes unsaved parent edits; includes revision dependencies
|   |   `-- Reuse C09/D00: Saved CanvasViews and branching
|   |-- Child CanvasViews record parentViewId and forkCheckpointId
|   |   `-- alternativeGroupId = runId; each candidate has a viewId and chatId
|   `-- Save child records and request receipt; schedule independent starts
|-- Child chat launch: AgentChatService.launchGeneration()
|   |-- Inherit model, effort, access settings and tool definitions
|   |-- Fork parent thread at its turn boundary
|   |   `-- Or start a thread and inject immutable saved AgentContext reference
|   |-- Distinct thread, MCP binding and one managed turn per candidate
|   `-- Clear inherited goal; nested generation is disabled
|-- Child canvas execution: GenerationCanvasBridge
|   |-- add(): create isolated MappingDocumentController from pinned history
|   |   `-- Each child owns document binding, history, command queue and receipts
|   |-- Headless read/snapshot and guarded apply/revision/batch/context edits
|   |   `-- Retry identical commands; await persisted exported history
|   `-- Parent fork management stays with live CanvasSessionBridge
|-- Progress and cancellation: CanvasGeneration / cancelGeneration()
|   |-- queued -> generating -> finished, failed or cancelled
|   |-- Track prompts, timing, token usage and waitingForInput
|   |-- Cancel child -> interrupt turn -> finishGeneration(); parent interrupt
|   |   `-- Also cancels its running generation children
|   `-- Restart marks running generations failed; retained chats stay reviewable
`-- Result retention and parent synchronization: finishGeneration()
    |-- FileChatStore saves chat, terminal metadata and child history first
    |   `-- Serialized writes use temporary file plus atomic rename
    |-- syncGeneration() -> live parent canvas-generation update
    |   |-- Finished history -> CanvasHistory.updateGeneration() validates/imports
    |   |   `-- Append candidate checkpoint; advance that saved view's endpoint
    |   `-- Failed/cancelled states synchronize metadata without result history
    |-- Parent unavailable: retain result and report pendingSave
    |   `-- generations() retries on reconnect using stable workspace identity
    `-- Clear binding/remove child controller; retain chat for review
        `-- CanvasView result synchronization is separate from catalog publication
